concerns.location: tasks.md:T004 vs spec.md:FR-002/FR-003 and constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: T004 computes 'global linearity' as trustworthiness(high_dim, pca30) and 'local continuity' as trustworthiness(pca30, high_dim) — i.e., neighborhood preservation relative to a PCA-30 embedding. FR-002/FR-003 and Constitution VI require Trustworthiness (k=15) and the LCA metric computed on the high-dimensional space PRIOR to any dimensionality reduction, as predictor variables. The reversed-trustworthiness trick is not the LCA metric. This silently redefines what FR-002/FR-003 measure.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 vs specs/.../contracts/fidelity_results.schema.yaml and spec.md US-2 AS-3
concerns.text: T006 writes the literal string "Unavailable" into ari/nmi columns, but the fidelity contract requires numbers in [0,1] (additionalProperties: false, required numeric fields). The jsonschema validation T006 itself promises would fail on any Unavailable row. Also US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires 'every dataset-method combination has a valid ARI and NMI value (no nulls)' — the Unavailable fallback weakens this without a spec-recorded exception.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T007 vs spec.md:FR-006 and plan.md Phase 0.3
concerns.text: T007 fits fixed-effects ANOVA and sets is_descriptive_mode=true when only 1 dataset is available, but FR-006 mandates the mixed-effects model `fidelity ~ method + (1|dataset)`. Plan Phase 0.3 requires a spec update to Case-Study mode BEFORE downstream tasks; spec.md still mandates the mixed model and three datasets. The narrowing is implemented in the task without the recorded spec change — retroactive narrowing.

FR-007/SC-001 define the sensitivity sweep over Silhouette THRESHOLDS {0.4, 0.5, 0.6} with variance in ARI/NMI across that sweep. T008 computes stability_passed from variance across the Leiden RESOLUTION sweep (0.1–1.0); the Silhouette-threshold variants are 'also evaluated' but do not feed stability_passed. SC-001's pass/fail logic is silently re-anchored to a different swept variable.

T010's combined_metrics.parquet uses columns trustworthiness/local_continuity, but the metrics_schema contract requires global_linearity (defined as variance-explained ratio) and local_density (PCA reconstruction error) with additionalProperties: false. The task's output cannot conform to the active contract; either the contract or the task must be reconciled, not silently diverged.

Plan mandates HVG count N as 'the elbow point of the variance curve (dynamic, no hard-coded number)'; T001/T004 hard-code top 2000 HVGs with dynamic N only 'permitted'. The plan's stated method is not what the task implements.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005 vs spec.md US-1 Acceptance Scenario 3
concerns.text: Spec requires 'three distinct 2D/3D coordinate sets'; T005 produces a 30-dimensional PCA embedding. Either reconcile the spec wording or the task's n_components — currently the deliverable falls outside the stated acceptance scenario.

FR-002 specifies '[deferred] randomly sampled cell pairs' for computational feasibility of Trustworthiness; T004 implements only cell-subset sampling, leaving the deferred pair-sampling mechanism unnamed in the task (the metric and reference are named, but the feasibility mechanism the FR calls for is absent).
